versions.changelog:
- No user-facing changes in this release.
- Internal version bump only; no updates to documentation or code.

- Removed all helper and wrapper scripts for the AgentFiles CLI.
- Skill now runs AgentFiles commands directly via the installed CLI, simplifying command usage.
- Updated documentation to reflect the direct use of agentfiles CLI instead of wrapper scripts.
- Preserved core behaviors and usage patterns, but dropped all internal script-based command resolution and onboarding.

- Initial release of the agentfiles skill, providing a wrapper around the AgentFiles CLI.
- Enables publishing, fetching, searching, listing, sharing, and watching AgentFiles artifacts across multiple agent runtimes.
- Prefers using a locally installed agentfiles binary, falling back to the agentfiles-cli npm package when necessary.
- Includes helper scripts for running commands and setting up onboarding or credential flows.
- Preserves CLI behaviors without reimplementing API calls, unless specifically requested.
